character.look: a beautiful young Chinese woman in her early twenties, soft round face, warm brown eyes, long black hair with wispy bangs
character.wardrobe: a muted red outdoor jacket over a cream knit sweater, dark trousers and comfortable walking shoes; the same clothes in every shot
character.manner: She is a real traveller, not a model: relaxed, unhurried natural walking, quiet curiosity, calm natural expression. No posing, no nodding, no waving, no talking, no gestures at the camera, mouth closed. Hands are anatomically correct with five fingers.
